TournamentState.title: TournamentState
TournamentState.description: Stores the configuration, matches, and real-time voting state of the championship

competitionLogo.description: Base64 or URL of the competition logo

juryCount.description: The exact number of judges required to vote

currentMatchId.description: ID of the currently active match, or null

matches.description: Matches array containing current scores, states, and statuses

juryVotes.description: Key-value pair mapping juryId to vote

warnedJuries.description: ID list of judges warned by the admin

configured.description: Whether the tournament configuration has been completed

tournamentSize.description: Total size of the tournament grid

state/current.description: Singleton document containing our live tournament state synchronized across all devices
